final: WITH g AS (SELECT order_id, COUNT(*) AS c FROM Invoices GROUP BY order_id), s AS (SELECT SUM(c) AS tot FROM g WHERE c IS NOT NULL), sh AS (SELECT g.order_id, g.c AS c, 1.0*g.c/s.tot AS share FROM g JOIN s ON s.tot IS NOT NULL), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS av FROM sh WHERE share IS NOT NULL), k AS (SELECT sh.c AS c, sh.share AS share, a.av AS av FROM sh JOIN a ON a.av IS NOT NULL WHERE sh.share > a.av) SELECT SUM(c) AS total_count, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(share - av) AS avg_diff FROM k
